story.title: Story 5: Attach And Import Existing PI Sessions

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two prior blockers and directly touched surfaces: import-wide serialization against live capture, partial-import repair scoping, importer issue ranges, focused Story 5 tests, and configured gates. I did not perform a broad full-story re-review beyond confirming Story 5 AC/TC coverage evidence remained intact after the fixes.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by wrapping attachExistingPiSession() in withSerializedThreadOperation(threadId) after pre-create conflict/path validation and routing imported entries through captureFinalizedActivityInCurrentThreadOperation(), so the full create/import/finalize path holds the same per-thread queue used by live capture. The new regression test "serializes live capture behind an in-progress import so it cannot land inside the imported range" proves live capture waits while import is paused after two imported appends, then lands at sourceOrder 4 after importedSourceRange {1,3}.

Resolved by deriving repair-needed ranges from actual import issues via sourceRangesFromIssues() and passing those ranges to repairNeededTurns(), rather than passing the full imported range. The updated regression test "marks only affected imported turns repair_needed when one imported message is partial" proves a partial issue at sourceOrder 4 leaves the first turn ready and marks only the affected second turn repair_needed.

additionalObservations: npm run verify passed with 75 unit tests.

npm run verify-all passed; its integration leg still reports "No integration tests found." This is a pre-existing project layout gap noted by the implementor, but the configured epic gate exits successfully.

No material fake adapter, placeholder branch, shim, or non-real production execution path was introduced in the touched Story 5 production code. Test-only fakes remain confined to tests/context-steward/import-service.test.ts.
